description: Alphanumeric key in the form TCGA-XX-XXXX, unique per patient.
rule: Taken as recorded. One row per patient; the key used for every join between tables.

description: Age in years at diagnosis.
rule: Taken as recorded and converted to a number (years).

description: Race as recorded by TCGA; blank when not recorded.
rule: Taken as recorded. TCGA placeholders set to blank (02_clean.R).

description: Ethnicity as recorded by TCGA (Hispanic or Latino, or not); blank when not recorded.
rule: Taken as recorded. TCGA placeholders set to blank (02_clean.R).

description: Year the patient was diagnosed.
rule: Taken as recorded and converted to a number.

description: FIGO clinical stage as recorded; blank when not recorded (5 patients).
rule: Taken as recorded. TCGA placeholders such as [Not Available] set to blank (02_clean.R).

description: FIGO stage at diagnosis, grouped into I-II, III and IV; blank when stage was not recorded (5 patients).
rule: Stage IA, IB, IC, IIA, IIB and IIC grouped as I-II; IIIA, IIIB and IIIC as III; IV as IV. Any other value left blank (05_ard.R, section 2).

description: Size of the largest tumour left after primary surgery, as recorded; blank when not recorded (67 patients).
rule: Taken as recorded. TCGA placeholders set to blank (02_clean.R).

description: Residual tumour after primary surgery in three groups (none, 1-10 mm, over 10 mm); blank when not recorded (67 patients).
rule: No Macroscopic disease as none; 1-10 mm as 1-10 mm; 11-20 mm and >20 mm as over 10 mm, following du Bois et al. 2009 (05_ard.R, section 3).

description: Tumour grade as recorded; blank when not recorded (4 patients).
rule: Taken as recorded. G4 and GB are flagged in flag_grade_check; GX kept as recorded.

description: Primary site of the disease (ovary or peritoneum), from the ICD-10 code.
rule: ICD-10 C56.9 as ovary; C48.0, C48.1 and C48.2 as peritoneal (05_ard.R, section 4).

description: Whether lymphovascular invasion was recorded; blank when not recorded (365 patients).
rule: Taken as recorded. TCGA placeholders set to blank (02_clean.R).

description: Days from diagnosis to the start of first-line platinum treatment; blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients).
rule: Earliest start day among platinum drugs (drug_lookup.csv) that started within 180 days of diagnosis (04_treatment.R, section 3).

description: The platinum agent used in first-line treatment; blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients).
rule: The platinum drug group from drug_lookup.csv for first-line platinum rows; more than one if the rows have different groups (04_treatment.R, section 3).

description: Whether a taxane was given alongside first-line platinum; blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients).
rule: yes if any drug in the taxane group (drug_lookup.csv) started within 180 days of diagnosis, otherwise no (04_treatment.R, section 4).

description: Number of first-line platinum cycles recorded; blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients) or with no cycle count (33 patients).
rule: Highest recorded cycle count across the patient's first-line platinum rows; blank if any is missing (04_treatment.R, section 3).

description: Whether the patient died (1) or not (0, censored).
rule: 1 if a death day is recorded on the patient form or any follow-up form, otherwise 0 (03_survival.R, section 7).

description: Days from diagnosis to death, or to last contact if the patient was alive; blank when no usable time was recorded (3 patients).
source: death_days_to and last_contact_days_to in clinical_patient_ov and clinical_follow_up_v1.0_ov
rule: Earliest recorded death day if os_event is 1; otherwise the latest last contact day across all forms (03_survival.R, sections 2, 3 and 7).

description: Whether there was a new tumour event, or death with tumour, at any time after diagnosis (1) or not (0, censored).
source: new_tumor_event_dx_days_to in clinical_nte_ov and clinical_follow_up_v1.0_nte_ov; tumor_status in clinical_patient_ov and clinical_follow_up_v1.0_ov; os_event
rule: 1 if a new tumour event is recorded in either new tumour event table, or if the patient died while recorded as with tumour on any form; otherwise 0 (03_survival.R, section 8).

description: Days from diagnosis to the first new tumour event, or os_days when there was no event; blank when no usable time was recorded (3 patients).
source: new_tumor_event_dx_days_to in clinical_nte_ov and clinical_follow_up_v1.0_nte_ov; os_days
rule: Day of the first new tumour event if there is one; otherwise os_days (03_survival.R, section 8).

description: Days from diagnosis to the last first-line platinum dose; blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients) or with no end date (36 patients).
rule: Latest end day across the patient's first-line platinum rows; blank if any end day is missing (04_treatment.R, section 3).

description: Days from the last first-line platinum dose to the first new tumour event (the platinum-free interval); negative when the recurrence came before the last dose; blank when there is no first-line platinum, no end date or no recurrence (272 patients).
source: derived from the first new tumour event day (03_survival.R) and last_platinum_days
rule: Day of the first new tumour event minus last_platinum_days; negative when the recurrence came before the last dose (04_treatment.R, section 5).
window: From the last first-line platinum dose

description: Response to first-line platinum at a six-month cut-off: resistant, sensitive, too early, died without recurrence or no end date; blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients).
source: derived from platinum_free_days, last_platinum_days, os_days and os_event
rule: Checked in order, first match used: no end date if last_platinum_days is blank; resistant if a new tumour event came less than 183 days after the last dose; sensitive if it came 183 days or more after; sensitive if no new tumour event and at least 183 days of follow-up after the last dose; died without recurrence if no new tumour event and died less than 183 days after the last dose; otherwise too early (04_treatment.R, section 6).
window: From the last first-line platinum dose

description: The same response classification as platinum_status, using a 12-month cut-off instead of six months (sensitivity analysis S1); blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients).
source: derived from platinum_free_days, last_platinum_days, os_days and os_event
rule: The same rules as platinum_status with 365 days in place of 183 throughout (04_treatment.R, section 7).
window: From the last first-line platinum dose

description: Which form recorded the death day (patient form, follow-up form or both); blank when no death was recorded (239 patients).
source: derived: which of clinical_patient_ov and clinical_follow_up_v1.0_ov recorded death_days_to
rule: both if the patient form and a follow-up form recorded a death day; otherwise the form that did (03_survival.R, section 2).

description: Which table recorded the first new tumour event; blank when no new tumour event was recorded (225 patients).
source: derived: which of clinical_follow_up_v1.0_nte_ov and clinical_nte_ov recorded the first new_tumor_event_dx_days_to
rule: The table holding the patient's first (earliest) new tumour event: followup_form or separate_form (03_survival.R, section 5).

description: Flags patients whose forms record more than one different death day.
source: derived from death_days_to in clinical_patient_ov and clinical_follow_up_v1.0_ov
rule: TRUE if the forms record more than one different death day; the earliest is used (03_survival.R, section 9).

description: Flags patients recorded as dead with no death day on any form.
source: derived from vital_status and death_days_to in clinical_patient_ov and clinical_follow_up_v1.0_ov
rule: TRUE if any form records vital status Dead but no form has a death day (03_survival.R, section 9).

description: Flags patients whose last contact is recorded after their death day.
rule: TRUE if the latest last contact day is after the death day (03_survival.R, section 9).

description: Flags patients with no usable overall survival time (os_days blank).
rule: TRUE if os_days is blank (03_survival.R, section 9).

description: Flags patients whose first new tumour event is recorded after death.
source: derived from first new_tumor_event_dx_days_to and death_days_to
rule: TRUE if the first new tumour event day is after the death day (03_survival.R, section 9).

description: Flags patients with a survival or new tumour event day before diagnosis.
source: derived from os_days and first new_tumor_event_dx_days_to
rule: TRUE if os_days or the first new tumour event day is below 0 (03_survival.R, section 9).

description: Flags patients whose recurrence came before their last first-line platinum dose; blank for patients without first-line platinum (96 patients).
rule: TRUE if platinum_free_days is below 0; blank for patients without first-line platinum (04_treatment.R, section 5).
window: From the last first-line platinum dose

description: Flags patients with grade G4 or GB, neither expected in this cohort.
rule: TRUE if grade is G4 or GB (05_ard.R, section 5).

description: Whether the patient is included in the logistic regression model.
source: derived from platinum_status, age, stage_group and residual_group
rule: TRUE if platinum_status is resistant or sensitive and age, stage_group and residual_group are all recorded (05_ard.R, section 8).

description: Flags patients the TCGA-CDR marks as redacted; the CDR does not give a reason.
rule: TRUE if Redaction is Redacted for the patient's barcode (05_ard.R, section 8b).
